description: The Fukushima Prefectural Centre for Environmental Creation publishes calculated monthly suspended-radiocesium flux through the University of Tsukuba's ERAN repository. The dataset covers 27 river monitoring sites within 80 km of Fukushima Daiichi from September 2015 to March 2017. Its own method combines discharge and suspended-solid estimates with measured 134Cs and 137Cs concentrations, then integrates the resulting flux monthly. The published delimited file is free under CC BY 4.0. The underlying sensors sampled every ten minutes, but that is not the resolution of this deposit. These flux estimates can calibrate catchment contaminant mass balances and downstream infrastructure-exposure simulations, including models constructed with model-openfoam. A caveat is that abnormal turbidity values were filled using discharge-concentration rating curves. Reported uncertainty includes counting error and a 95% rating-curve prediction interval. Older periods are referenced separately. No flux file or underlying sensor observations were downloaded.
